decks.notes: This deck focuses on sacrificing creatures for value and dealing incremental damage to the opponent. It utilizes cards like Mayhem Devil, Cauldron Familiar, and Claim the Firstborn to create a synergistic engine that can chip away at the opponent's life total while disrupting their game plan. The deck also includes powerful removal spells like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize to control the board and protect its own creatures. Overall, the key strategy is to sacrifice creatures, generate value, and overwhelm the opponent with a relentless assault.

The main concept of this deck is to ramp up mana quickly and efficiently through green devotion cards like Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx and Elvish Mystic, while also utilizing cards like Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner and Cavalier of Thorns to generate card advantage and board presence. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with powerful creatures like Old-Growth Troll and Polukranos Reborn, supported by cards like Storm the Festival to find them quickly. Additionally, the inclusion of Karn, the Great Creator provides utility and disruption, making this an aggressive green-based deck with a strong devotion theme.

The key concept of this deck is to quickly and aggressively fill up the graveyard with cheap spells and then bring back multiple Arclight Phoenixes to overwhelm the opponent. The deck includes card draw and cheap spells to trigger the Phoenix's ability, as well as removal spells to deal with threats on the opponent's side. The land base is optimized to support the deck's strategy, ensuring a fast and efficient gameplay. The inclusion of Temporal Trespass and Galvanic Iteration adds extra power and versatility to the deck's gameplay.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on disrupting opponents with cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push while applying pressure with aggressive creatures like Bonecrusher Giant and Bloodtithe Harvester. It also utilizes the graveyard with Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger and Graveyard Trespasser to continue applying pressure. The deck has a mix of removal spells and creatures to maintain board control and push through damage quickly. The mana base includes utility lands like Den of the Bugbear and Hive of the Eye Tyrant to enhance the deck's overall strategy.

This deck focuses on aggressive play with a Rakdos color combination, utilizing efficient removal spells like Fatal Push and Go for the Throat to clear the way for powerful creatures like Bonecrusher Giant and Bloodtithe Harvester. Thoughtseize and Duress disrupt opponents' plans, while Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger pressures opponents' hands. The deck also includes disruptive planeswalkers like Liliana of the Veil and strong finishers like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse. The mana base is designed to support the color requirements of the deck while providing utility with cards like Urborg, Tomb of Yawgmoth and Castle Locthwain.

This deck focuses on aggressive strategies with powerful creatures and disruption spells to control the game. The key idea is to quickly apply pressure on the opponent with efficient creatures like Bonecrusher Giant and Bloodtithe Harvester, while disrupting their game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push. The deck also utilizes powerful finishers like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker to close out games. Overall, the goal is to overwhelm the opponent with early threats and disruption, leading to a quick victory.

The main concept of this deck is to efficiently ramp up mana using green devotion cards such as Llanowar Elves and Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx. This allows the player to quickly cast powerful green spells like Cavalier of Thorns and Old-Growth Troll. Additionally, cards like Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner and Storm the Festival help to generate card advantage and provide additional mana sources. The inclusion of Karn, the Great Creator and Boseiju, Who Endures offers flexibility and protection against opposing strategies. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with big creatures and overwhelming board presence.

This deck aims to utilize the combo potential of Retraction Helix alongside cards like Kinnan, Bonder Prodigy and Mox Amber to generate infinite mana and creature tokens. The deck focuses on ramping early game with mana dorks like Llanowar Elves and Sylvan Caryatid, while also using Lukka, Coppercoat Outcast and Karn, the Great Creator to search for combo pieces. Atraxa, Grand Unifier and Tyvar, Jubilant Brawler provide additional support and synergy with the deck's strategy, creating a strong and consistent combo deck in the Pioneer format.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly fill the graveyard with instants and sorceries in order to bring back Arclight Phoenix from the graveyard and deal damage to the opponent. The deck includes a variety of card draw and discard spells to help achieve this goal, as well as removal spells to control the board. It also utilizes the powerful Treasure Cruise and Temporal Trespass to refill the hand and keep the pressure on the opponent. The mana base is carefully constructed to support the deck's aggressive game plan.

This Izzet Control deck focuses on controlling the board with removal spells like Spikefield Hazard and Strangle, while also countering opponent's spells with cards like Spell Pierce. The deck aims to draw cards and gain card advantage with Treasure Cruise and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker. Crackling Drake provides a powerful threat while also drawing cards. The deck runs a mana base that includes lands that can produce both blue and red mana, allowing for flexibility in casting spells. Overall, the deck aims to control the game and outvalue the opponent.

This deck focuses on aggressive tactics utilizing the synergy between Rakdos creatures and removal spells to quickly disrupt the opponent's game plan and apply pressure. The deck includes powerful creatures like Bonecrusher Giant, Kroxa, and Sheoldred, as well as efficient removal spells like Fatal Push and Go for the Throat. By combining these elements, the deck aims to maintain board control and pressure the opponent into making unfavorable trades, ultimately leading to a victorious outcome through aggressive plays and disruption.

The main strategy of this deck revolves around utilizing the Lotus Field card to generate a large amount of mana quickly, enabling the player to cast powerful spells such as Omniscience and Emergent Ultimatum. By using cards like Sylvan Scrying and Vizier of Tumbling Sands to find and untap Lotus Field, the deck aims to ramp up to its big payoff cards efficiently. Additionally, the deck includes various ways to search for key pieces and protect the combo, such as through Hidden Strings and Dark Petition. Overall, the deck focuses on assembling its combo pieces quickly and efficiently to overwhelm the opponent.

This deck focuses on using a combination of cheap, evasive Spirit creatures and tempo plays to quickly pressure the opponent while disrupting their game plan. By protecting its creatures with counterspells like Spell Pierce and Lofty Denial, and utilizing cards like Rattlechains and Shacklegeist to keep the opponent off balance, the deck aims to maintain a fast clock while disrupting the opponent's resources. Curious Obsession provides card advantage to keep the pressure up, while cards like Spell Queller offer additional disruption options. The deck also includes some land destruction in the form of Geistlight Snare, and a big finisher in Otawara, Soaring City.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize Jeskai Ascendancy's abilities to combo off with cards like Retraction Helix, Mox Amber, and Emry, Lurker of the Loch to generate infinite mana and draw your entire deck. With cards like Saheeli, Sublime Artificer and Portable Hole providing additional synergy, the deck aims to win the game through a powerful and intricate combo sequence. The backup plan includes control elements like Tormod's Crypt and Spikefield Hazard to disrupt the opponent?s strategies while setting up the combo. This deck requires precise sequencing and careful planning to execute the combo efficiently and overwhelm your opponent.

The primary focus of this deck is to quickly assemble a combo using Transmogrify to potentially cheat a powerful creature into play. The deck includes tools like Impulse','','');">Fiery Impulse, Spell Pierce, Fading Hope, and Make Disappear to control the game and protect the combo. With the help of cards like Impulse and Atraxa, Grand Unifier, the deck aims to generate value and create a favorable board state before ultimately transitioning into a game-ending play with Transmogrify. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds consistency and versatility to the strategy.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through counterspells, removal, and card advantage. It aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy while generating value through cards like Dig Through Time and Sinister Sabotage. Shark Typhoon provides a win condition and a way to create threats while protecting the player's life total. Narset, Parter of Veils helps with card advantage and shutting down opponent's draw spells. The deck also includes a mix of board wipes like Shadows' Verdict and targeted removal like Fatal Push. Overall, the goal is to outvalue and outlast the opponent in a grindy game.
